records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the three months ended March 31, 2024, revenue was approximately $355.7 million, an increase of $95.8 million or 37% from $259.9 million for the three months ended March 31, 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: This growth was primarily the result of increased revenues from North America (including Canada), from which first quarter 2024 revenues were $339.5 million, an increase of $90.9 million or 37% from the same period in 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: North America's increase was driven by continued gains in distribution points and SKUs per location, offset in part by inventory movements by our largest distributor, where first quarter 2024 inventory days on hand declined versus the fourth quarter 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: For the quarter ended March 31, 2024, selling, general and administrative ("SG&A") expenses totaled $99.0 million, up 44% or $30.1 million from $68.9 million in the same quarter of 2023.

records.title: 10-Q
records.text: Cash flows provided by operating activities totaled $134.6 million for the three months ended March 31, 2024, which compares to $13.8 million cash used in operating activities for the three months ended March 31, 2023.
